references.phrase: inverse image f^{-1}(U) for an open U
references.context: Topology: inverse image of open subset under continuous underlying scheme map

references.phrase: suffices to test affine opens of S
references.disposition: Affine opens give a local base for this quasi-compactness condition; do not assume every open is affine.

review_rationale: Reviewed inverse images of all quasi-compact open subsets of S and the equivalent test on affine open subsets. The quasi-compactness is of the preimage, not necessarily of X or of S globally.
